svg.text: Ashen Lantern · 2D style sheet v0.1 · original art, hand-authored SVG
lantern thief · hooked staff, stolen cage, candle crown
spent soul · burnt-paper crown, last ember between the ribs
boss · melted-candle crown, wax beard, caged soul
Silhouette first. Every foe must read as solid soot at 64 px: one big shape, one prop, one quirk.
Amber is light, never decoration. Only flames, the lantern, ornament and crits. One to three warm points per enemy.
Teal is the Gloam. Enemy eyes, caged souls, corruption and the target ring. Heroes never get teal.
Light comes from the party. Rim-light (#3A3640) on lantern-facing (left) edges; enemies face left.
Cut-outs over lines. Detail = negative space (ribs, cages, hood mouths), not thin outlines.
VectorDrawable-safe. Paths, circles, flat fills + alpha, evenodd. No filters, masks or blur. 512×512 canvas, feet on y≈478.
Animate in code. Idle bob/sway, lunge on attack, eye flare on hit, ash-dissolve on death. No frame sheets.
